name: killallgit
description: Killallgit workflow skills for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: catch-up
plugins.description: Rebuild a human's lost context on the work in flight after reconciling the current checkout's dangling changes — commit what belongs to an open PR, discard what already landed, sync the branch — then summarize the state of play, decisions, live PRs and tickets, and the single next step. Use when the user says "catch me up", "where were we", "what's the state of this", "get back on track", or invokes `/catch-up` after time away.

plugins.name: check-agent-docs
plugins.description: Review and clean up a project whose root has both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md — shared instructions live once in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md imports them with `@AGENTS.md` instead of repeating them, and every checkable claim in either file still matches the repo. Use when the user says "check the agent docs", "check project", "dedupe CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md", or invokes `/check-agent-docs`. Does nothing unless both files exist.

plugins.name: end-session
plugins.description: Bring this session's branch up to date, land or discard its work, and archive the session.

plugins.name: follow-the-rules
plugins.description: Core programming rules for all agents and users alike. The following documents contain the most important, fundamental, rules that every engineer - junior to principle - MUST follow.

plugins.name: git-janitor
plugins.description: Clean up local Git when the user says "clean up our local git", prune the repo, or review stale branches and worktrees. Inspect uncommitted and unpublished work in every worktree first, discard work that is superseded or over 60 days old when justified, then remove merged and stale local worktrees and branches. Record what was discarded and why.

plugins.name: independent-review
plugins.description: Get the current branch reviewed by a reviewer that did not write it. Opens a PR if none exists, runs CodeRabbit when available, otherwise a fresh-context local review agent, then resolves the findings.

plugins.name: session-eject
plugins.description: Save all work before usage runs out — commit, push, update or open draft PRs, and stop. `now` skips waiting for subagents.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Open PR, wait for CodeRabbit, fix findings, merge, sync main, clean up. Use when the user says "ship it", "ship this", or invokes `/ship`.

plugins.name: wait-for-action
plugins.description: Wait for a GitHub Actions run to finish, or for the CodeRabbit review of HEAD with --coderabbit. Use when a workflow has been triggered and later work depends on it passing, when you need to know why a run failed, or when the user says to wait for CodeRabbit.
